allocator: Instrumented System allocator requested sizes, including reallocations; excludes allocator metadata, OS mappings and GPU
latency_scope: Tick wall time; save/load are in-memory engine Snapshot encode/hash/validate/restore, not filesystem durability latency
host_limits: Shared Intel N97 host; concurrent compilation/verification contention during comparison. Not an exclusive CPU measurement or universal speedup.
Times include allocation instrumentation. Historical 51-sample probes are not reused as current evidence.

Sustained RSS includes the preallocated timing vector being paged in (8 MB for one million u64 samples), snapshot allocator retention and prior workload residue. Rising RSS alone is not a measured leak.
No GPU or physical-device performance claim.
